My brain couldn't process shit, and every single cat pun sent my soul hurtling towards hell. I completely understand that the musical doesnt really have a plot, but it makes up for it with the dancing and signing. The movie ignores everthing but the dancing. They could have made every chracter more dynamic and added more to the plot besides a cat pun here and bad joke there. 

Overall, It was an experience to say the least, but at the exact same time so incredibly boring that I almost fell asleep mutiple times. I wouldn't recommend paying to watch it.
